title: Academic Search Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Finds scholarly papers, books, and research across academic sources. The Academic Search Engine finds scholarly papers and research. It searches across journals, conferences, books, and preprint archives, ranks results by relevance and citation count, and shows abstracts, citation counts, and access options. Filters narrow by year, field, and peer-review status so the student finds sources that count.
capabilities: Search journals, conferences, books, and preprints
Rank by relevance and citation count
Show abstracts, citations, and access options
Filter by year, field, and peer-review status
Save and organize search result sets

demo.title: Core operation executed
demo.code: const docs=[{id:1,text:'spaced repetition improves recall'},{id:2,text:'massed practice is weaker'},{id:3,text:'sleep aids memory'}];const hits=docs.filter(d=>d.text.includes('repetition')).map(d=>d.id);J({hits});assert(JSON.stringify(hits)==='[1]','search');
